Huize Frankendael and Restaurant Merkelbach (opens in a new tab) regularly look for new colleagues, from kitchen to service and events. Below are the roles we recruit for; feel free to email and ask what is currently open.

  • Pot washer

Apply via geert@restaurantmerkelbach.nl, attn. Geert Burema.

Service (Dutch speaking)

  • Restaurant manager
  • Experienced serving staff

Apply via info@huizefrankendael.nl, attn. Bodo Groen.

Internship

Intern, operational event management — Vacancy (PDF). Apply via info@huizefrankendael.nl, attn. Bodo Groen.

Nothing that fits, but enthusiastic anyway? Send an open application to info@huizefrankendael.nl.
